svg.title: Your Mind grows in the learning loop and sharpens your working loop with AI
svg.desc: A figure-eight dual-loop diagram sharing Your Mind at center: the left learning loop connects Your AI Assistant, Your Second Brain, and Daily Cards with a dashed feedback chord from cards to the assistant; the right loop represents real work with AI.

g.text: Working Loop · Human in the Loop
Broader reach for the next study
New puzzles at workcan feed the left loop
AI executes · returns results & open questions
Left loop builds your own knowledge network and brightens Your Mind; right loop brings that wider reach back into real work with AI.
